judged_text: The removal of the refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse failure branch also removed the console.error that logged the zod error and the raw Microsoft response, and its replacement throws a generic 'Invalid refreshed tokens were returned'. Operators debugging Outlook refresh failures lose the only artifact that identified what Microsoft actually returned (the error shape and response body), turning a previously diagnosable failure into an unattributable one.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous `if (!tokenResponse.success) { console.error(..., tokenResponse.error, ..., responseJson) }` branch was removed when switching from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on parse failure and does not log the Zod error or the raw Microsoft response body. This is a real observability/debuggability regression for operators, but it doesn't by itself prove functional breakage.
